docs.title: SHARP — Smart Hostel Administration and Resource Platform
docs.text: SHARP is a centralized platform for managing hostel administration and resource-management workflows.

docs.title: Modules
docs.text:
• Leave & Visitor Management
  • Mess Management
  • Room Allotment
  • Maintenance Complaints
  • Laundry Feedback & Tracking

docs.title: Work Done
docs.text:
I was responsible for preparing the project report for the Student Room Allocation System.

I collected the required information about the project and organized it into the report. I documented the project objectives, system features, three user portals, room allocation functionality, development process and testing.

I also arranged the screenshots and formatted the report to make it clear and presentable.

docs.title: My Contribution
docs.text:
• Prepared the project report.
  • Documented the system functionality.
  • Added details about the Student, Parent and Caretaker portals.
  • Documented the room allocation feature.
  • Added and organized screenshots.
  • Formatted and reviewed the final report.

docs.title: Outcome
docs.text: The complete project report was prepared and finalized for submission.
